title: Optimizing Spectral Signature in Code Backdoor Detection
abstract: arXiv:2510.13992v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into software development workflows, they also become prime targets for adversarial attacks. Among these, backdoor attacks are a significant threat, allowing attackers to manipulate model outputs through hidden triggers embedded in training data. Detecting such backdoors remains a challenge, and one promising approach is the use of Spectral Signature defense methods that identify poisoned data by analyzing feature representations through eigenvectors. While some prior works have explored Spectral Signatures for backdoor detection in neural networks, recent studies suggest that these methods may not be optimally effective for code models. In this paper, we revisit the applicability of Spectral Signature-based defenses in the context of backdoor attacks on code models. translated_title: 优化代码后门检测中的谱签名方法
translated_abstract: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）日益融入软件开发工作流程，它们也成为对抗性攻击的主要目标。其中，后门攻击是一种重大威胁，攻击者可以通过嵌入在训练数据中的隐藏触发器来操纵模型输出。检测此类后门仍然是一个挑战，而一种有前景的方法是使用谱签名防御方法，该方法通过特征向量分析特征表示来识别被投毒的数据。虽然此前已有一些工作探索了谱签名在神经网络后门检测中的应用，但近期研究表明，这些方法对代码模型可能并非最优有效。在本文中，我们重新审视了基于谱签名的防御方法在代码模型后门攻击背景下的适用性。我们在各种攻击场景和防御配置下系统性地评估了这些方法的有效性，并分析了……
tldr: 本文重新审视并系统评估了谱签名防御方法在检测代码模型后门攻击中的有效性，探索其在不同攻击场景和防御配置下的优化应用。
en_tdlr: This paper revisits and systematically evaluates the effectiveness of Spectral Signature-based defenses for detecting backdoor attacks on code models across various attack scenarios and defense configurations.
